notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
Tweak to input system to try and avoid missed or double clicks
 Couple of text corrections

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Release
notes.content:
Version 1.0.2

More options to move between clues, mouse wheel, left and right arrows and forward and back buttons will now move between clues
Input detection moved to happen on each update, rather than each frame to hopefully fix missed inputs
Shep the helper dog can now be turned off after activating him. (You monsters, he's just doing his job!)

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1
Requested feature added

Animation frequency can now be changed. You can turn it off altogether but that will make the dogs sad. (Press "A" on your keyboard to make them move if you need to)
